artifact.rawData:
Breakout #1: 10 principles for preaching + teaching youths
-----------
(*) Preaching is a sacred work (1 Thess)
	- Take the small moments to speak for God. 
	- sermon that has shaped my life... was it practical, relevant (personal), evoked an emotional response, practical with a service.
	- convicting and calls for change.

(1) Saturate your sermon in prayer.
- remove ritual from your prayer
- john 15:5 -> how do we abide with Jesus? Through prayer, how do we teach others to pray.
- illumination, discerment, and that he must increase and I must decrease.

(2) We preach out of the overflow of what God is doing in our lives.
- "Dead men deliver dead sermons. Dead sermons kill."
- Lack of discipline in other areas of our live.

(3) Only the work of God transforms, preach diligently.
- Nehemiah 8:8 -> "They gave the sense" , speak the work CLEARLY and CATER to those who don't understand. 
- Why is my teaching too much about me and not enough God.
    - Not enough prayer time?
    - Fallacy in thinking that God's word is not enough.
    - Do I understand what I am reading?

(4) Assume your audience is biblically illiterate
- Teaching in context of the passage you're discussing.
- Who wrote, when written and why was it written?

(5) Preach the Gospel every time we teach.
- Tie it back to Jesus, he is the main character.
- Ask how you can get the students to see Jesus every time we teach.
    - When outlining, trace those passages or shadows back to jesus
- Tie back that one-sentence declaration

(6) The text is the main course , the imagery are the sides.
- 2 Tim 2:15

(7) Relay on the power of the Holy Spirit
- Does your teaching touch your heart?
     - if not, partner with the Holy Spirit in preparation

(8) Let your passion match the text
- The Gospel is a matter of life or death. Teach with those stakes in mind.
- Teach with the urgency and forcefulness to create an environment of conviction

(9) Keep the Big Idea
- lets teach them one single theological truth each session.

(10) We must preach for a response.
- If we dont get those responses, hearts become hardened. 
- What is our repsone to this passage, how does this transform me?



--------
Recruiting new laypeople
- invite vs recruit.
- We don't partner with parents or youth ministry. We serve them.
    - How can i serve a single mom, dad, foster kids. Changes mindset and the posture of the volunteers.
- As a new testament, we are not only called to spectate but to teach/serve/engage.




Train volunteers
- When training new volunteers in ministry, get them to love every ministry in church even if they're not involved in it.
- We are here to integrate with the ministry, it'll make you a better parent, grandparent, son, daughter, friend.
- Train them to be good listeners too, especially to parents. Work together to the same goal, build relationships.




Celebrate in their success
- Youth worker wing-dings
    - dinner and fellowship with the leaders
    - celebrate the leader, reminding them they are valuable and they are impactful.


------
